faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Kanpur Nagar Panel Lawyer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DLSA Kanpur Nagar Panel Lawyer recruitment is 06 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Panel Lawyer post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Panel Lawyer post, candidates must be an Advocate registered with the Bar Council and possess more than 3 years of active experience as per NALSA guidelines. This ensures that applicants have the necessary legal expertise.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out carefully, attach the required documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for DLSA Kanpur Nagar Panel Lawyer posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DLSA Kanpur Nagar Panel Lawyer recruitment. This makes the application process more accessible to a wider range of eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Panel Lawyer position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Panel Lawyer position will involve an Interview and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages before final selection.
